metadata.description: Personal software engineering factory for enterprise .NET work and the UIs on top of it.

plugins.name: dotnet-factory
plugins.description: Repo-aware pipeline for .NET backend work: discover, investigate, plan, build, verify, review, deliver. Ships guardrail hooks and a deterministic gate.

plugins.name: ui-factory
plugins.description: UI pipeline on top of dotnet-factory: design-system inventory, UI build, browser verification (desktop/mobile, RTL/LTR), and an independent UI reviewer.
